label: Take part
heading: Where is yours, and what is it like?
intro: Body mapping asks where a sensation sits, how it behaves, and what it is nearest to. You will be shown eight details cut from paintings, without titles. Choose the one closest to your own sensation and the painting it came from will be revealed, along with where it sits in the exhibition.
disclaimer: Nothing here is stored or sent anywhere. It is a way of describing, not a way of measuring, and it is not a diagnosis or medical advice.
step1_hint: Tap anywhere on the outline. Tap again to clear.
step2_caption: Details from paintings by Asmita Sarkar. You are not meant to recognise them yet.
step3_sublabel: up to three, from any of the rows
